name: planning_agent
description: Turns a Jira card, its ranked services and its answered questions into a plain-English technical design and a work order, reading code only through GitHub's API.

triggers.name: planning_input
triggers.description: The card as JSON: {"card": {key, type, title, description, files}, "services": [{service, repo, branch, rank, reason, prs, path}], "questions": [{question, answers}], "issue_key" (optional)}.

triggers.name: attachments
triggers.description: Optional: the card's files (images, PDFs, text). Add one, then more. Describe each in Planning input under card.files, with the same name: {"name": "screenshot.png", "description": "what it shows"}.
